groups.defect: In Google updateEvent/deleteEvent, the fallback branch runs only when externalCalendarId is falsy, but it searches destinationCalendar by cal.externalId === externalCalendarId. The search never matches, so the fallback is always undefined.
groups.rationale: All five report the same broken find comparison in the same fallback code, and each covers both updateEvent and deleteEvent. They give the same fix: fall back to the first destination calendar.

groups.defect: mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration is read without optional chaining, so it throws a TypeError when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All six point at the same line of the Google Meet fallback in EventManager and ask for the same `?.` fix.

groups.defect: evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars) does nothing when destinationCalendar is null, so a collective event drops the team members' calendars. Filling teamDestinationCalendars inside async map callbacks is also fragile.
groups.rationale: Both report the same no-op push on a null destinationCalendar in handleNewBooking. s_a6c93c38 also mentions the fragile async-map population.
